notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch via probe.fetch (curl_cffi), HTTP 200 on every one of ~200 requests; no proxy, no r.jina.ai, no rate limiting hit. Next.js SSR storefront, so every PLP ships its full data in <script id="__NEXT_DATA__">. ROBOTS: https://www.danubehome.com/robots.txt EXPLICITLY NAMES CLAUDE AND ALLOWS IT - 'User-agent: anthropic-ai / Allow: /' and 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Allow: /' (alongside GPTBot, CCBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, Bingbot, all Allow: /). No Crawl-delay is declared; probe.py's 2s/host gap was applied anyway. The User-agent:* block disallows */danube-deals/*, /my-account/*, /cart/*, /checkout/*, /*catalogsearch, /ae/en/c/search/, /ae/en/c/clearance-sale/, /*categories/, /*?page=1 and a long list of ?filter= query parameters - none of those paths were requested. Paging used ?page=2..N only (never ?page=1, and no disallowed filter parameter), which is outside every Disallow pattern. TREE - THREE INDEPENDENT SOURCES MERGED: (1) the live /ae/en mega-menu parsed off the rendered homepage HTML (Menu_menuSubDiv id="Bath" -> Menu_menuLevelListInner blocks), which gives 13 Bath groups; (2) each PLP's own child-category strip (Plp_plpTopCategoryContainer), recursed top-down from /c/bath; (3) the full category sitemap https://www.danubehome.com/ae/en/sitemap/category_sitemap_ae_en.xml (1,538 category URLs, 89 of them under /c/bath). 95 candidate paths were fetched and each was validated on four signals: HTTP 200, rendered H1, metaDataFromServer.categoryId equal to the requested path (this is how aliases were caught), and a non-zero product total. The Bath department (h1 'Bathware', 825 products) has 13 groups: Mixer 129, Rain Shower 145, Vanity 75, Mirrors & Cabinets 34, Bathtub & Shower Room 26, Valves & Drains 38, Wash Basin 25, Kitchen Sink 29, Water Heater 9, Accessories 213, Ancillaries 22, Shattaf 42, Water Closet 37. A second genuine bathroom node lives outside that department: Laundry & Organizers > Bathroom Accessories (219) with children Accessory Singles 173 and Accessory Sets 46. QTY: the PLP's own rendered listing header, 'N Results for "<Category>"' (div Plp_productCountinfo), which is SSR'd from pageProps.totalProductsFromServer in __NEXT_DATA__. Both were read on every node and AGREED ON ALL 95 (e.g. /c/bath renders '825 Results for "Bathware"' and totalProductsFromServer = 825), so the structured number is provably the rendered number, not a substitute for it. VERIFICATION: (a) EXHAUSTIVE ENUMERATION - the Mixer, Rain Shower and Accessories subtrees (the three largest and the only ones whose arithmetic did not close on first inspection) were paged to exhaustion via ?page=2..N and their unique SKU sets collected: bath/mixer 129 unique SKUs vs total 129, basin-mixer 38/38, shower-mixer 33/33, sink-mixer 24/24, art-mixer 18/18, complete-set 8/8, rain-shower 145/145, shower-column 13/13, shower-panel 20/20, complete-shower-set 26/26, hand-shower 1/1, head-shower 57/57, concealed-shower-mixer-set 29/29, bath/accessories 213/213 and all 14 of its children - enumerated count equalled the reported total in every single case. (b) SUBSET PROOFS - all 121 Mixer-child SKUs and all 4 Sink Mixer-Wall Mounted SKUs are inside bath/mixer's 129 (4 parent-only orphans remain, all bath/shower mixers); all 208 Accessories-child SKUs are inside bath/accessories' 213 (5 parent-only orphans: 2 Tatay toothbrush holders, 1 Milano side cabinet, 2 towel rings); all 6 Rain Shower children sit inside the parent's 145. (c) EXACT ARITHMETIC CLOSURE on Water Closet 37 = 1+3+9+1+13+10, Wash Basin 25 = 4+14+7, Valves & Drains 38 = 11+27, Shattaf 42 = 8+34, Vanity 75 = 70+4+1, Kitchen Sink 29 = 21+8, Laundry Bathroom Accessories 219 = 173+46, Bath Textiles 2063 = 1340+723, Bathroom Tiles 185 = 125+25+35. (d) COUNTS DISCRIMINATE - 46 leaf values ranging 1 to 173, no repeated site-wide constant. (e) H1/BREADCRUMB MATCH - every recorded leaf's H1 and its products' categoryLevel1>2>3 breadcrumb match the node requested (spot-verified on 10 nodes, e.g. bath/accessories/tumbler-holder products carry 'Bath > Accessories-Bath > Tumbler Holder'). (f) NO CROSS-DEPARTMENT DUPLICATION - bath/accessories (213 SKUs) and laundry-and-organizers/bathroom-accessories (219 SKUs) were set-intersected and share ZERO SKUs, so recording both is not double counting; the first is Milano chrome/metal bathroom hardware, the second is Velora/Adelyn glass, resin and marble bathroom accessory ware. ALIASES CAUGHT AND EXCLUDED AS DUPLICATES (rule 28) - each returned a categoryId different from its own path: /c/bath/accessories/dryer -> bath/accessories/hand-and-hair-dryers; /c/bath/water-closet/wc-accessories -> bath/water-closet/wc-seat-covers (the canonical URL the mega-menu links, recorded); /c/bath/mirrors-cabinets/mirror-cabinet -> bath/bathroom-mirrors-cabinets (renders the parent, 34, NOT a distinct listing); /c/home-decor/home-accessories/bathroom-accessories -> bath/accessories; /c/home-decor/bathroom-accessories -> laundry-and-organizers/bathroom-accessories; /c/bath/bath-laundry -> laundry-and-organizers; /c/bath/bath-laundry/bath-accessories -> laundry-and-organizers/bathroom-accessories; /c/tiles-and-bricks/tiles-by-space-bathroom (185) duplicates Bathroom Tiles. MIRRORS & CABINETS CAVEAT (stated rather than papered over): the group totals 34 and its products' breadcrumbs split into two third-level types, 'LED Mirror' and 'Mirror Cabinet'. Only LED Mirror has a working distinct listing URL (/c/bath/mirrors-cabinets/led-mirror, 29, H1 'LED Mirror'); /c/bath/mirrors-cabinets/mirror-cabinet renders the parent instead. Per rule 24 the parent URL was NOT recorded because a valid child listing exists, so 5 mirror-cabinet products sit under the grouping row with no leaf of their own - no URL was invented for them. These bathroom mirrors ARE included per rule 10/11 (primary type is mirror, incl. LED/illuminated/anti-fog and mirror cabinets); the LED Mirror node also carries magnifying mirrors. EMPTY NODES FOUND AND NOT RECORDED (0 products, verified live, no fake rows): bath/rain-shower/shower-kit 'Hand Shower with Handle' 0; bath/accessories/magnifying-mirror 0 (its magnifying mirrors are merchandised inside LED Mirror); bath/bath-tub-shower-room/luxury-shower-room 0; bath/bath-tub-shower-room/free-standing-bathtub-shower/bathtub-and-dispenser-gift-combo 0 (also a gift combo, rule 25); laundry-and-organizers/laundry-solutions/bathroom-trolley 0. OTHER EXCLUSIONS: bath/mixer/free-standing-shower-mixer (7) is a mislabelled legacy category - all 7 of its products are freestanding BATHTUBS whose own breadcrumb is 'Bath > Bathtub & Shower Room > Free Standing Bathtub & Shower', and SKU intersection shows 0 of its 7 are in bath/mixer; it duplicates the recorded Free Standing Bathtub & Shower leaf (also 7) and is not in the mega-menu or any PLP strip, so it was dropped as a duplicate rather than recorded twice. bath/essential-storage (2) holds Falcon pedal bins whose breadcrumb is 'Laundry And Organizers > Cleaning Tools > Waste Bin' - general cleaning/storage, not bathroom, and not in the nav. bath/bath-laundry/tissues-toilet-paper-and-sprays (1) is a non-navigable legacy node holding one folding commode chair. Promotional / brand-collection pages excluded per rule 25: bath/new-arrivals 181, bath/milano 1602, bath/golden-milano-set 29, bath/ideal-standard-collection 10, bath/emailer-sanitary1 59, bath/sanitary-combo 1, bath/sanitary-super-saver-ae 198, bath/sanitary-super-saver-bh 69 (a Bahrain page on the UAE store), bath/uae-10-percent-off-bathware 825, c/sanitary-sale. Home Decor > Wall Decor > Mirrors (135) and Furniture > Bedroom Storage > Dressing & Mirrors are decorative/bedroom mirrors owned by Home Decor and Furniture respectively (rules 10/11/29) and were not duplicated here. Laundry & Organizers > Cleaning Tools > Waste Bin (150), Cleaning Mops (982 parent) and Laundry Solutions (90) are general household cleaning/laundry, not bathroom. Electronics & Appliances washing machines and dishwashers are appliances. BATHROOM LIGHTING: none exists. The Lights department is Lighting By Type / Shop By Room (Bedroom, Dining, Living, Staircase) / By Material / By Collection / Electricals / Outdoor, and grepping all 1,538 sitemap category URLs under /c/lighting/ for bath|vanity|mirror|shaving|wash returned zero hits - so nothing was routed to Lighting for this company. || CROSS-FILE DEDUP: 3 leaf record(s) removed as already extracted in a prior category workbook.
